text:
The person you clicked with
last week?

They're not going to
follow up with you.
Not because they don't like you.
sub:
Because they're doing what you're doing:
assuming it'll happen on its own.
Every silent week cuts the odds.

“Good meeting you. I'm going again
next week — you in?”

text:
That's it. That's how
acquaintances become friends.
